description: E189. The words of criteria, proof and sign-off on a chain step, beside ophiolite.chain-reasons/1, which is unchanged. `reasons`: why a declaration with criteria, or a sign-off, exception or continue on a step with criteria, was refused, one closed key each, one sentence each; nothing was stored (the HTTP status of each is the service's `criteria.STATUS`). `criterion_states`: the words a person reads for each criterion state. `step_states`: the words of the four states of a step with criteria. `proof_kinds`: what each kind of proof asks for, with its placeholders. `since_sign_off`: one sentence per change after a sign-off. `unavailable`: the sentence every criteria row answers until it is served. Placeholders are in braces; no sentence carries a code.

reasons.work-without-criteria: A step done outside the platform needs a list of criteria that says when it is done.
reasons.criteria-not-here: Only a step whose result is attached can have criteria: a tool step or a step done outside the platform.
reasons.duplicate-criterion: Two criteria of this step have the same key.
reasons.role-unknown: The sign-off names a role this chain does not list.
reasons.role-unused: This chain lists a role that no step's sign-off names.
reasons.duplicate-role: Two roles of this chain have the same key.
reasons.input-not-upstream: A criterion about current inputs must name an earlier step that this step follows.
reasons.rule-parameters: The rule a criterion names is not released for this kind of result, or a value is not one the rule accepts.
reasons.per-well-kind: Only well logs can be counted per well.
reasons.holder-not-member: Everyone named for a role must be a member of this project who can do work in it.
reasons.proof-outcome: A criterion names an outcome this project does not have for this kind of result.
reasons.outside-retired: A step done outside the platform is now declared as work, with the criteria that say when it is done.
reasons.not-named-for-role: Only a person this chain names for the role can sign off this step.
reasons.agent-cannot-sign: Only a person can do this on a chain step.
reasons.not-a-member: Only a member of this project can record or withdraw an exception.
reasons.cannot-read-proof: You cannot open every record this step's criteria rest on, so you cannot sign it off.
reasons.input-moved: An input changed after this page was read; read the step again before signing off.
reasons.no-exception: There is no exception on this criterion to withdraw.
reasons.step-not-open: This step is not open for this.
reasons.nothing-attached: Nothing is attached to this step yet.
reasons.has-criteria: This step has criteria: it is done when they hold and a person signs it off, never by continuing.

step_states.done-with-exception: Done with an exception, signed off by {person}

proof_kinds.made-from: Made from at least {count} {item words} per {per}
proof_kinds.current-input: Made from the current result of "{step}"
proof_kinds.rule: The rule "{rule}" holds with the team's values

since_sign_off.newer-input: A newer version of an input was published after the sign-off.
since_sign_off.attachment-replaced: The attachment was replaced after the sign-off.
since_sign_off.attachment-withdrawn: The attachment was withdrawn after the sign-off.
since_sign_off.exception-withdrawn: An exception was withdrawn after the sign-off.
since_sign_off.verdict: The verdict on the result changed after the sign-off.

unavailable: Criteria and sign-off on a step are not available on this deployment yet.
